description: A 16-band vocoder after the Moog Spectravox: a program signal is split into 16 bands, each band's level is measured, and those levels are imposed on a carrier split through a matching bank

params.text: Sets the internal VCO's pitch over -54 to 36 semitones, with the centre detent at middle C, 261.63Hz, and the V/OCT input added to it
Switches the internal VCO between a sawtooth and a pulse, shown by the SAW and PULSE lamps
Sets the duty cycle of the internal VCO's pulse wave, 1 percent to 50 percent, and does nothing while the wave is set to SAW
MIX knob — crossfades the carrier between the CARRIER input, or the internal VCO if that jack is empty, and the internal noise; fully anticlockwise is carrier and fully clockwise is noise
Sets the gain on the program signal before analysis, 0 to 3 with 1 as the starting point, through a soft saturation that gets harder as the gain rises
FORMANT knob — moves the synthesis bank up or down against the analysis bank, a quarter of the band frequencies fully anticlockwise, unshifted at centre and four times fully clockwise
Sets the Q shared by all 16 synthesis filters, 0.7 fully anticlockwise up to 15 fully clockwise
Sets the LFO speed, 0.05Hz fully anticlockwise up to 500Hz fully clockwise; the lamp beside it blinks with the LFO and stays solid once the knob passes three fifths of its travel
Sets how much of the LFO reaches whatever LFO target is set in the panel menu, none fully anticlockwise
Sets the level of that band in the output, 0 for silence, 1.0 for unity and 1.5 at the top; a double-click returns it to 1.0 and a double-click with Cmd or Ctrl held sets it to 0
Switches the internal noise source between white and pink, shown by the WHITE and PINK lamps
Switches between VOCODER, where each synthesis band is opened by the matching band of the program, and FILTER BANK, where every band stays open and the sliders act as a fixed equaliser
Sets both the release of the envelope followers and the decay of the EG together, 1ms fully anticlockwise to 5 seconds fully clockwise
Sets the level of the MIX, EVEN and ODD outputs together
Switches the output VCA between EG, which opens it only while the EG is running, and ON, which holds it open
TRIGGER button — fires the EG while it is pressed, and resets the LFO phase as well when LFO sync is set to Reset on trigger
FREEZE button — latches the 16 band envelope followers at the values they hold, so the band outputs and the band VCAs stop moving; a cable in the FREEZE input overrules it
Turns on firing of the EG from the program signal, shown by a green lamp when on and a red one when off; the EG fires once the program envelope passes 6V and re-arms once it drops below 2V
Switches the band envelope followers between a 0ms attack and a 40ms attack, shown by the FAST and SLOW lamps

inputs.text: The signal that is analysed, usually a voice; it sets how much of the carrier gets through in each band, and it is read on one channel
The signal that is filtered and heard; with nothing patched the internal VCO supplies it, and a polyphonic cable is averaged down to one channel first
Sets the level of the MIX, EVEN and ODD outputs, 0V for silence up to 10V for full, with negative voltages read as 0V; the maker's tooltip says -5V is silence and 0V unity, which the code does not do
Sets the internal VCO's pitch at 1V per octave on top of the PITCH knob, and a polyphonic cable makes one VCO per channel whose outputs are averaged into one signal
Shifts the internal VCO's pulse width, -5V to 5V covering the whole 1 percent to 50 percent span from the PULSE WIDTH knob's setting, and it has no effect while the wave is set to SAW
Multiplies the LFO rate by two for every volt, so 1V doubles the speed the RATE knob sets and -1V halves it
TRIGGER input — a rising edge past 1V fires the EG, and resets the LFO phase as well when LFO sync is set to Reset on trigger
FORMANT input — adds to the FORMANT knob, 10V shifting the synthesis bank by the knob's whole travel and -10V by the same amount downwards
FREEZE input — latches the band envelope followers at their present values while it reads 2V or more; with a cable patched here the FREEZE button does nothing
Sets the level of that band's VCA, 0V to 8V for closed to fully open, in place of the band's envelope follower unless Band CV mode is set to Sum with envelope

outputs.text: MIX output — the 16 bands summed, through the output VCA and VOLUME, around 5V at a healthy setting
The LFO, a triangle running from 0V to 5V
The EG, 0V to 8V, falling from 8V at the rate DECAY sets each time it is fired
The envelope follower on the whole program signal, 0V to 8V, before it is split into bands
The envelope follower for that band, 0V to 8V, tracking how much of the program signal is in that band, and latched at its present value while FREEZE is on
Bands 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14 and 16 summed, through the output VCA, VOLUME and the VCA CV input, clamped to -12V and 12V
Bands 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13 and 15 summed, through the output VCA, VOLUME and the VCA CV input, clamped to -12V and 12V

notes: a new module comes up with VCA MODE on EG, so the output stays silent until the EG is fired: press TRIGGER, patch a gate to the TRIGGER input, or set VCA MODE to ON.
the PROGRAM LEVEL knob doubles as the sensitivity for PROG TRIG EG, because the EG is fired from the program envelope measured after that gain is applied.
the module is monophonic at the output. The V/OCT and CARRIER inputs accept polyphonic cables but average their channels into one signal, and every output writes one channel.
the EXPANDER lamp lights only when a module with the slug Astravox-VocoderExpander is placed to the right. No such module exists in this version, so the lamp never lights.
menu: Sibilance — adds a highpassed copy of the program signal, taken above the top band, straight into the output, which makes s and f sounds carry
Band 1: LP → BP — turns band 1 from a lowpass into a bandpass, in both the analysis and the synthesis bank
Band 16: HP → BP — turns band 16 from a highpass into a bandpass, in both the analysis and the synthesis bank
Band spacing: LIN, MEL, BARK — sets the 16 band frequencies; LIN runs 100Hz to 8000Hz, MEL spreads that span evenly by perceived pitch, and BARK runs 50Hz to 2900Hz on the critical bands
Band CV mode: Replace envelope (default), Sum with envelope — sets whether a patched band CV input takes the place of that band's envelope follower or is added to it
LFO target: Spectrum (default), PWM, Both — sets what the DEPTH knob sends the LFO to: the formant shift, the VCO pulse width, or both at once
LFO sync: Free (default), Reset on trigger — sets whether the LFO runs on regardless or starts again from zero phase each time the EG is fired
Reset all faders to unity — puts all 16 band sliders back to 1.0
Set all faders to zero — puts all 16 band sliders to 0
